description: Seinposten is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Een seinpost is een installatie die toelaat om de wissels te bedienen, de reiswegen vast te leggen en de seinen te bedienen om het treinverkeer in alle veiligheid te laten verlopen in haar actiezone. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Traffic beheer, Veiligheid. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
